quote: The Side Letter governs indemnification claims under Delaware law and in the Delaware Court of Chancery, while the SPA and Escrow Agreement are governed by New York law and subject to New York jurisdiction. Because the Side Letter has first priority (SPA §11.11), indemnification disputes will be litigated in Delaware under Delaware law, while other disputes (e.g., purchase price adjustment under §2.4, specific performance of closing conditions) will be in New York under New York law.
reason: Issue D covers every element of the criterion. It names Side Letter §6 (Delaware law and Chancery) and the conflict with SPA §11.8/§11.9 (New York law and courts). It says the §11.11 precedence clause lets the Side Letter control. It explains the resulting forum split and the risk of inconsistent rulings. It also recommends conforming the Side Letter to New York.
